detailed_descriptions.en: Beat, Heart, Beat is a handcrafted amalgamation of fast-paced action platformers and rhythmic precision. Featuring a unique directional slash system, dash through each enemy by aiming in their direction to the music. Perform wild air combos as you soar across the Psyche, encountering a wide array of enemies that will test your aim and your metronome! The Heart has gone missing. In its wake, Amalgamation is twisting the withering Psyche into something unrecognizable. Guide the puppet Peccori through a broken, surreal world, recruiting a variety of strange characters that'll help you during the action and on the road. Beat, Heart, Beat is a game about people living their lives in an absurd world. Backed by a a grungy alt-rock soundtrack, experience a surreal, reflective story pieced together with mixed-media presentation. Features: An accessible Story Mode with handcrafted cutscenes and mini-games Over 15 rhythm-platforming levels with Normal and Hard variants Custom Level Editor with Steam Workshop support Free Play mode with extra-evil Heartless charts for hardcore players An expressive mixed-media art style featuring 2D animation, 3D, FMV and collage art. An entirely original alt-rock soundtrack A troupe of bizarre characters that help (and hinder) your journeyㅤ ㅤ ㅤ

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Beat, Heart, Beat is a handcrafted amalgamation of fast-paced action platformers and rhythmic precision. Featuring a unique directional slash system, dash through each enemy by aiming in their direction to the music. Perform wild air combos as you soar across the Psyche, encountering a wide array of enemies that will test your aim and your metronome!

The Heart has gone missing. In its wake, Amalgamation is twisting the withering Psyche into something unrecognizable. Guide the puppet Peccori through a broken, surreal world, recruiting a variety of strange characters that'll help you during the action and on the road.

Beat, Heart, Beat is a game about people living their lives in an absurd world. Backed by a a grungy alt-rock soundtrack, experience a surreal, reflective story pieced together with mixed-media presentation.

Features:

  • An accessible Story Mode with handcrafted cutscenes and mini-games

  • Over 15 rhythm-platforming levels with Normal and Hard variants

  • Custom Level Editor with Steam Workshop support

  • Free Play mode with extra-evil Heartless charts for hardcore players

  • An expressive mixed-media art style featuring 2D animation, 3D, FMV and collage art.

  • An entirely original alt-rock soundtrack

  • A troupe of bizarre characters that help (and hinder) your journeyㅤ
